scope: USCM, synthetics, bosses and Bad Blood use the shared CombatDirector; no browser or human testing is claimed by this report.

changes.uscm: Support against the hive by default; holds cover instead of targeting a player who cannot attack these soldiers. Explicit hostileToPlayers opt-in remains available for future encounter code.
changes.fire_cadence: Simulation-time cooldowns replace per-render-frame random firing probabilities.
changes.synthetics: Ranged attacks reserve a shared turn and prepare for0.9seconds; nearest living cooperative target is selected. EMP, bisection, death and cleanup release reservations.
changes.bosses: Passive45/65HP-per-second body contact removed. Contact strikes and signatures prepare before one impact, then recover. A three-pod embryo volley can damage each player at most once.
changes.bad_blood: A blade strike prepares for0.9seconds; plasma prepares for1.1seconds. The rush stops during preparation.
changes.warnings: An orange preparation ring precedes reserved attacks, remains at worldY0.035 for scaled actors, and owns disposable private resources. This is a preparation cue, not a precise damage-area outline.

covers: Six seconds of close multi-faction contact during a seven-second startup grace produces no damage; actual windup precedes the first hit.
A single player never faces simultaneous faction windups or stacked same-step impacts; hostiles still damage after the opening.
USCM only damages hive targets by default.
Ten-second fire counts remain within one shot at10fps,60fps and120fps.
Synthetics choose the nearest living cooperative player and transfer after death.
Three overlapping embryo pods cannot produce three damage events.
Scaled, vertically animated actors keep warning rings on the combat plane.
Cleanup removes scene resources and all shared attack reservations.
